walls.note: Occluded rear wall. The 2025 crop and aimed view show a cream-stuccoed building with a rounded corner, shutters and the GELDERSEKADE street sign; the pand's 6.1 m rear wall is straight in the BAG ring (no rounding), so that is the neighbouring building in front of it. Nothing of this pand is visible.

52 deg oblique 2017 view across the Oudezijds Kolk: red-brick warehouse fronts with white stone arch blocks, segmental-arched barred ground windows and red-and-white shutters on a grey plinth at the water. This 4.3 m segment of the BAG ring lies in the long south-west party line (all its segments face 233-236 deg) behind those houses; their fronts stand at the quay, so the photo shows neighbouring panden, not this wall. Nothing of this pand is confirmed visible.

walls.note: East part of the Prins Hendrikkade front (ring t 0-4.04 m; the BAG ring sets the 2.43 m entrance bay back 0.48 m, which in the photo is only the ground-storey porch: above it the front is flush), rectified 2025 crop w04-341.jpg with the 2024 alt and the aimed view. Amsterdam School: very dark purple-brown brick, a grid of five tall windows per storey between slender brick mullion-piers, four storeys, brick spandrel panels with sculpted reliefs, corbelled bands, a heavy parapet.
